WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of green chalk
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a white chalk ring and works white chalk and herbs into green chalk. Five white sticks and twenty herbal medicines become five sticks of green chalk beside the altar.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of star chalk
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a green chalk ring and sets white chalk, silver and jade under the stars. Five white sticks, ten silver and ten jade become five sticks of star chalk beside the altar.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of components
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a green chalk ring and draws a component out of raw steel and herbs. Thirty steel and fifteen herbal medicines become one industrial component beside the altar.
